relationship: Supplement to prayer-source-certification-inventory.v3.json, NOT a parallel canonical prayer corpus
scope: Sixteen novena source links, digital-witness source-page type, original practice requirements, material reading caveats
sourceMethod: Identified principal online witness pages and section/context from historical transcriptions and the existing donor register. URL access is not proofread facsimile collation. Unchecked entries are explicitly noted.

records.sourceWork: Blessed Be God: A Complete Catholic Prayer Book
records.edition: New York: P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1925
records.finding: The book's page is titled Christmas but contains a separate complete Pentecost section with nine numbered days.

records.sourceWork: Blessed Be God: A Complete Catholic Prayer Book
records.edition: New York: P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1925
records.finding: The same page opens with dated Christmas prayers; Pentecost is a separate following chapter heading.

records.sourceWork: The Catholic Prayer Book and Manual of Meditations
records.finding: 1883 book explicitly instructs beginning Wednesday in Pentecost week; the nine prayer days may include feast day.

records.sourceWork: The Catholic Prayer Book and Manual of Meditations
records.finding: Linked historical Sacred Heart Novena present; full French literal witness still pending.

records.sourceWork: The Catholic Prayer Book and Manual of Meditations
records.finding: 1883 text prescribes 29 November opening and multiple shared prayer elements.

records.sourceWork: Mary, Help of Christians: Novenas in Preparation for the Principal Feasts of the Blessed Virgin
records.finding: Hammer Section III has nine Annunciation days; transfer-aware 1962 annual feast date not yet consistently bound.

records.sourceWork: Mary, Help of Christians: Novenas in Preparation for the Principal Feasts of the Blessed Virgin
records.finding: Hammer Section V contains nine Assumption meditations, not a separate nine-page book.

records.sourceWork: Mary, Help of Christians: Novenas in Preparation for the Principal Feasts of the Blessed Virgin
records.finding: Hammer Section IV contains nine distinct Seven Sorrows texts.

records.sourceWork: The Catholic Prayer Book and Manual of Meditations
records.finding: 1883 prayer-book St Joseph novena; independent trilingual collation outstanding.

records.sourceWork: Novena for the Holy Souls in Purgatory
records.edition: Traditional English prayer-book recension; public-domain original
records.finding: Original printed attribution and digital transcription still require independent checking.

records.sourceWork: With God: A Book of Prayers and Reflections
records.finding: Wikisource page 699 is explicitly flagged not proofread: do not assert word-for-word source certification.

records.sourceWork: Novena of the Twenty-Four Glory Bes to St Thérèse of Lisieux
records.finding: EWTN reproduces a described 1925 devotion: 24 Glory Bes daily, ninth to seventeenth monthly preferred, not an original 1925 manuscript.

records.sourceWork: Devotion of the Nine Tuesdays to St Anthony
records.edition: Australian Catholic Truth Society Franciscan pamphlet (1966) recording the older devotion; French Franciscan practice witness
records.finding: 1966 Franciscan pamphlet says no particular prayer mandatory, but suggests two invocations, three common prayers and Si quaeris.

records.sourceWork: Preces et Pia Opera / Thésaurisons pour le Ciel
records.edition: French collection aligned to Preces et Pia Opera, 1938
records.finding: The linked French historical prayer is adopted as a repeated novena form, without claiming one obligatory 9-day text.

records.sourceWork: The Raccolta · Prayer to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
records.edition: English Raccolta witness, 1857; traditional French devotional witness
records.finding: The linked Raccolta page witnesses a devotional prayer, not a day-specific nine-part novena.

records.sourceWork: Leonine Prayer to St Michael the Archangel
records.finding: Nine repetitions of a traditional prayer are a suggested devotion, not nine individually authored source days.
